title: Self Guided GoBoat Rental in Silver Springs
includes: Electric vessel, motor, and lithium battery
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the beautiful Silver River on a 2 to 4-hour self-guided GoBoat rental in Silver Springs. Cruise through crystal-clear waters and discover one of Florida’s most wildlife-rich waterways, where fish, turtles, and underwater vegetation are visible beneath your boat. Keep an eye out for the river’s famous wild rhesus monkeys along the shoreline and, during winter months, manatees gathering in the spring-fed waters. Your electric GoBoat launches and returns from Ray Wayside Park, giving travelers the freedom to explore at their own pace while enjoying a peaceful and eco-friendly boating experience. Please note that upstream travel is limited to approximately 1.5 mph against the current, so planning turnaround time is essential.
